# Pearl Blend Premium Tea

> Pearl Blend Premium Tea is a hand picked, 100% pure Ceylon black tea sourced directly from the tea estates of Maskeliya, Sri Lanka. It is packaged and distributed by S M J Ventures in Maharagama, Sri Lanka.

## Product
- Name: Pearl Blend Premium Tea
- Type: Ceylon black tea, rich and bold with a signature aroma
- Pack size: 500g
- Price: Rs. 1,200/= (LKR 1,200)
- Origin: Maskeliya, Sri Lanka

## How to brew
1. Place one teaspoon of Pearl Blend (premium tea) in a cup.
2. Add freshly boiled water and steep for 3 to 5 minutes.
3. Adjust strength to your preference.
